name: Demo Metadata Scraper
description: First-party example scraper: answers synchronous metadata.provider.query invocations from a local fixture. Built-in providers (TMDB/TVDB) always win; this plugin fills gaps or acts as the fallback base match when nothing else matched.

permissions.reason: Receive metadata provider queries with the recognition-layer lookup context.

configSchema.label: Fixture path
configSchema.helpText: Optional path to a JSON fixture mapping normalized titles to metadata.
